description: Shared benchmark configuration. Read by every language harness so each one builds the byte-identical matrix and runs the same operations. See README for the generation scheme.

generation.comment: Deterministic COO via the incremental modular map k_0=0, k_i=(k_{i-1}+stride)%(rows*cols), with row_i=k_i//cols, col_i=k_i%cols. 'stride' must be coprime to rows*cols (assert gcd==1 at startup) so the k_i are distinct -> no duplicate coordinates. Deterministic nonzero values: v_i = 1 + (k_i % value_mod). IMPORTANT: rows*cols, nnz, and all of k can exceed 2^31 (and may approach 2^53), so every harness MUST do this arithmetic in exact 64-bit integers -- Python ints are fine; R must use bit64::integer64 (NOT double, which silently loses precision past 2^53). rows*cols must stay below 2^63.

run.comment: Each operation is timed 'repetitions' times after 'warmup' untimed runs; report median + IQR downstream. CSR conversion is done once up front and is NOT timed. 'threads' is applied to BLAS/OMP env vars by the runner so we measure sparse kernels, not the BLAS.

output.comment: Tidy long-format CSV. Each script appends rows with these columns; merging is just concatenation. 'nnz' is written as an integer string to survive >2^31 values.
